capabilities: Sync NeoDB shelves, collections, notes, and reviews into vault notes
Preview files and cancel a running sync
Customize item, collection, note, and review output with Mustache-like templates
Organize synced notes into type-based folders such as book/ and movie/
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Supports custom NeoDB instances and English and Simplified Chinese UI.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull a user's NeoDB media library (books, movies, music, games) and its reviews into vault notes.
summary: Syncs NeoDB shelf items, collections, notes, and reviews into Markdown notes with preview, incremental sync, and customizable templates.
